what_this_is: The signed-off build every later change is measured against (owner, 2026-10-02: 'start with the guard and baseline'). A change that alters the model's view fails test_the_models_view_is_the_baselines until the sign-off set is re-run on it and matches or beats the results below; only then is this file moved to the new build.

conversation_reader.what_this_is: The conversation reader's view (design §39): everything it is shown for every message. It turns a follow-up or a reply into one complete question for the interpreter above, whose view is unchanged. Pinned like the interpreter's: a change to it fails test_the_models_view_is_the_baselines until the conversation bank is re-run on it and matches or beats the results recorded here.

candidate.what_this_is: A change to the model's view under measurement (design §40): it is deployed and measured BEFORE it replaces the baseline above. The guard accepts exactly this fingerprint as well as the baseline's, and nothing else; the candidate either becomes the baseline (the sign-off set matched or beat the results above) or is withdrawn.
candidate.change: Claude Opus 5.5: model claude-opus-5-5; effort low (Opus 5.5 always thinks; the signed-off build ran with the intent tool forced, so no thinking); the intent tool asked for in the prompt, not forced (Opus 5.5 rejects a forced call), and asked once more if a response has no call; server-side fallback on a safety-classifier decline; max_tokens 16000 for the thinking. The prompts, the catalogue and the tool schema are unchanged.
candidate.to_promote: run_production_bank.sh <principal> signoff on the deployed candidate; it must match or beat must_answer 88/88 and wrong_answers 0 above, with the variants scored by score_variants.py
